creator: Alexander Terp
description:
**Wanted:** `Pane.context_change` for OpenCode panes. API 0.4 reports it for Claude Code and Codex, and OpenCode reports neither kind.

**Not measured:** what OpenCode does on a clear or a compaction. The one recording, on `opencode/big-pickle`, only retried, so a recording that reaches a compaction comes first. `./dev --opencode` was not run for 0.23.0.
title: OpenCode: say when its context was cleared or compacted
